_README: Committed baseline the CI gate compares against. Every value here was produced
by a run recorded in eval/results/ - nothing is estimated or aspirational.
Each entry has a `value` (what we measured), a `min` (the gate threshold) and a
`margin`. Thresholds sit BELOW the measurement on purpose: a gate set exactly at
today's number fires on noise, gets disabled within a week, and then protects
Margins are not uniform. They are sized by how noisy each metric actually is:
- deterministic, local metrics (retrieval, Module B) get a small margin,
because the same index and checkpoint reproduce the same number exactly;
- metrics downstream of the LLM get a larger one, because generation varies
between runs even at temperature 0 and even with a fixed seed;
- parseable_citation_rate is the exception: it is a hard contract, not a
score, so its floor is 1.0 with no margin at all. One uncited sentence is
`value: null` means NOT YET MEASURED. The gate skips those and says so, rather
than treating a missing measurement as a pass.

retrieval_hit_rate.note: Deterministic given the index. Margin covers an index rebuild, which shifted chunk count 1612 -> 1615 once already.

evaluator_chunk_accuracy.note: Deterministic given the checkpoint and thresholds.

evaluator_macro_f1.note: Macro F1, not accuracy, so the `ambiguous` class keeps counting. It is the weakest class at F1 0.588 and the first thing a regression would hit.

parseable_citation_rate.note: A contract, not a score. No margin: one sentence without a resolvable citation is a defect, not noise.

invalid_id_rate.note: An invented source. Currently zero; the small margin allows one or two in 400+ sentences before failing.

citation_recall.note: Free when run against cached generations. Larger margin than the local metrics because it is downstream of the LLM.

citation_precision.note: Penalises citation padding. Same reasoning on margin as recall.

hallucination_rate_auto.note: Verifier-derived, not human-verified. It measures disagreement between the generator and Module D and inherits Module D's errors.

faithfulness.note: NOT YET MEASURED - the Phase 1 baseline has never run, because the API credit balance was exhausted. The gate SKIPS this metric and says so. It must not be given an invented threshold: the phase this gate exists to protect is the one whose number does not exist yet.
